name: Web task: a read-only browser task on a site with no API (per ticket)
cadence: on demand (via the build pipeline's web-task hook, bin/lib/web-task/route.sh, which enqueues one lane_runs row per ticket labelled web-task; Fly placement through lane_placement.web-task; no cron line)

knobs.note: Steps one web-task run may take (one step = one observation, one model call, one action). At the cap the run stops with status step-cap and the comment says the answer is incomplete.
Wall time of one web-task run. The agent checks it before each step and gives each model call at most the time left; at the cap the run stops with status time-cap.
0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row; the run ends refused-spend.

Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung (the BH-2533 registry default). The seeded row lane.web-task.llm_runner_allowed = claude sets it for this lane: its calls run with AGENT_CALL_NO_TOOLS=1, which every runner but claude refuses anyway; the row says so before the call.

Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows (GET /api/metrics/llm-spend). 0 = unlimited is the BH-2533 registry default; the seeded row lane.web-task.llm_usd_cap_day = 5 is this lane's cap. Over it, the next model call is refused before any spend and the run ends refused-spend. A project ceiling is the lane.web-task.<project>.llm_usd_cap_day row.

Characters of page text one observation (and one read action) hands the model. It sets the prompt size of every model call, so it drives the spend. bin/web-task.sh passes it to bin/web-task-agent.mjs as --text-chunk.
Clickable or typeable elements one observation lists for the model (the first N in page order). bin/web-task.sh passes it to the agent as --max-elements.

The most one model decision may take (the agent gives it the smaller of this and the wall time left). bin/web-task.sh passes it as --decide-max-s; bin/lib/web-task/decide.sh falls back to the same 120 when it gets no WEB_TASK_DECIDE_TIMEOUT.
Seconds past the decision timeout before the agent kills a decide command that did not exit. Passed as --decide-grace-s.
Screenshots one result comment carries (the last N of the run). The ticket caps it at 5. The agent keeps the last N (--keep-shots) and bin/lib/web-task/shots.sh publishes at most N.
Redirect hops one navigation may follow. Each hop passes the host check; past the cap the step ends with an error outcome. Passed as --max-hops.
Upper bound on one page navigation (goto). Never past the wall time left. Passed as --nav-timeout-s.
Upper bound on one settle wait, click or fill. Never past the wall time left. Passed as --action-timeout-s.
Upper bound on one screenshot and on the recovery goto to the last good page. Passed as --shot-timeout-s.
Seconds past WEB_TASK_MAX_S before the agent's backstop ends a run whose browser call hangs (status time-cap). Passed as --backstop-pad-s.
Past actions the model sees in each observation. It sets the prompt size, so it sets the spend. Passed as --history-actions.
Past refused actions the model sees in each observation. It sets the prompt size, so it sets the spend. Passed as --history-refusals.

The sleeps between result-comment post retries, one word per retry (whole seconds, 0..600 each, at most 5 words). An invalid list falls back to 5 20. Before each retry the lane re-reads the thread, so a post that landed is never posted twice.
Seconds past WEB_TASK_MAX_S before the lane timeout stops the agent process (the agent stops itself at WEB_TASK_MAX_S; this is the backstop for a hung browser).
Seconds after the lane timeout signal before a KILL (timeout -k).
How long the agent waits for `npm root -g` while it looks for playwright. Passed as --npm-root-timeout-s.
How long the agent waits for the browser to close after it wrote result.json, before it exits anyway. Passed as --close-timeout-s.
The wait after a click before the agent reads the page again. 0 = no wait. Passed as --settle-ms.
The wait after a scroll before the next observation. 0 = no wait. Passed as --scroll-wait-ms.
How far one scroll action moves the page. Passed as --scroll-px.
The most pages of 100 comments the lane reads from the issue thread. The read is the dedup-before-spend check, so a thread longer than this is rc 75 and no run (fail closed), never a partial read.
The most numbered actions the result comment lists; the rest is one '… and N more steps.' line.
The most guard refusals the result comment lists.
The most answer characters the result comment quotes. GitHub caps a comment at 65536 characters.
The most characters of the stop reason the comment shows for a run that did not finish.
Test seam: 1 lets the three WEB_TASK_* test seams below and WEB_TASK_PW_ROOT apply. Never set on a box.
Test seam, read only under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1: a file sourced after the real libs (stubs for gh_rest, setting_get, model_env_or_route, job_artifact_put).
Test seam, read only under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1: the decide command in place of bin/lib/web-task/decide.sh.
